title: Indian Market News Brief — 21 Oct 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Supportive global cues, positive GIFT Nifty signals, and strong festive consumer durables demand offer baseline market support. However, volatile global crude prices near $109/bbl due to Middle East geopolitical risks remain a key headwind. Investors are parsing key heavyweight events including HDFC Bank Q2 margin developments and the opening of the massive Reliance Jio IPO.

stories.headline: Reliance Jio IPO: Massive ₹30,213 cr issue opens for subscription today | Latest GMP, review, listing price prediction
stories.summary: Reliance Jio Platforms' mega ₹30,213 crore IPO opens for subscription with a price band set at ₹1,065–₹1,119 per share. The issue consists of a fresh issue of 27 crore shares. Strong demand from anchor investors and positive grey market trends precede the opening.
stories.impact: The large offering could absorb significant market liquidity while influencing valuation benchmarks for Reliance Industries and the telecom sector.

stories.headline: HDFC Bank has green shoots beyond Q2
stories.summary: HDFC Bank's Net Interest Margin (NIM) dropped to a 12-quarter low in Q2, though core operating profit grew and asset quality showed improvement. Management expects faster growth in higher-yielding loans to assist margin recovery.
stories.impact: Mixed operational cues may lead to near-term stock volatility, though steady asset quality could limit downside risks for banking heavyweights.

stories.headline: Oil prices rise on Red Sea shipping risks, threats to Saudi oil sites
stories.summary: Brent crude futures rose to $109.64 per barrel and WTI reached $98.58 amid escalating Red Sea shipping risks and security threats to Saudi energy infrastructure.
stories.impact: Elevated oil prices could heighten domestic inflation concerns and pressure margins for oil-consuming sectors like paints, auto, and aviation.

stories.headline: Gem, jewellery exporters heave a sigh of relief as the US puts off punitive tax
stories.summary: The US government has deferred punitive tariffs on Indian gem and jewellery exporters. The relief comes as lower domestic gold prices boost demand ahead of Christmas order cycles.
stories.impact: The tax deferral could support export volumes and earnings visibility for gem and jewellery manufacturers.

stories.headline: OYO-parent PRISM to nearly halve IPO fresh issue size to up to ₹3,350 cr: Sources
stories.summary: OYO parent PRISM plans to reduce its IPO fresh issue size by nearly half to up to ₹3,350 crore. Sources attribute the decision to consistent cash generation and improved balance sheet metrics.
stories.impact: Lower external capital raising requirements may enhance market perception regarding capital discipline in the primary market.

stories.headline: Consumer durables demand mixed; prefer LG, Polycab India: Motilal Oswal
stories.summary: Consumer durables sales expanded 25-30% year-on-year during the Navratri period after a slow start during Ganesh Chaturthi, according to Motilal Oswal research.
stories.impact: Strong festive demand could bolster third-quarter earnings expectations for consumer durable manufacturers and retailers.

stories.headline: Indian govt’s price correction of ethanol from maize may help balance distortion
stories.summary: The Indian government reduced the purchase price of maize-based ethanol by ₹3 per litre. The move faced opposition from grain-based distilleries while receiving support from the sugar industry.
stories.impact: Margin pressures may rise for grain-based ethanol producers, whereas sugar sector players could experience balanced market dynamics.

stories.headline: Stock market outlook today, 21 Oct: Sensex, Nifty prediction - DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
stories.summary: GIFT Nifty traded around the 23,031 level, up 96 points or 0.41% over the previous futures close, pointing to a firm start for Indian equities. Asian indices traded higher in tandem.
stories.impact: Positive early signals from offshore futures may support bullish momentum for benchmark Nifty 50 and Sensex indices at open.

stories.headline: CAMS eyes 20% share of revenue from non-core businesses in 2-3 years
stories.summary: Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) targets a 20% revenue share from non-core segments within 2-3 years. The firm has expanded into payments, AIF services, KYC registration, analytics, and data protection compliance.
stories.impact: Revenue diversification away from traditional mutual fund transfer operations may improve long-term business resilience.

stories.headline: Dividend, stock split, buyback: Last chance to buy today - VRL Logistics, JSW Dulux, Angel One shares
stories.summary: Corporate action record dates today include VRL Logistics' buyback date adjustment to October 22, JSW Dulux's 1:10 stock split, a ₹6.50 interim dividend for Tips Music, and a ₹1.40 dividend for Angel One.
stories.impact: Scheduled stock splits, dividends, and buyback adjustments are likely to trigger stock-specific trading activity.

stories.headline: Wall Street rebounds from lows as upbeat earnings, falling oil prices lift sentiment; Micron, Intel up 2%
stories.summary: US equity markets rebounded as upbeat corporate earnings and declining oil prices offset concerns surrounding AI infrastructure spending. Major indexes and semiconductor stocks closed higher.
stories.impact: Stabilization in US equities could support risk appetite and offer positive sentiment for domestic IT stocks.
